menu_book Verified Clinical Sources

SwasthaSathi clinical logic adheres to established public health guidelines from the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Govt of India.

privacy_tip Privacy Policy

1. Zero Unsolicited Data Retention

SwasthaSathi is engineered with strict patient privacy. Clinical symptom queries entered into the triage engine are processed ephemerally and never sold, monetized, or shared with commercial third parties.

2. Location Data Policy

Device geolocation is requested strictly with explicit user consent via the browser Geolocation API. Coordinates are used solely to compute nearby hospital distances via OpenStreetMap and are never tracked continuously or stored persistently without permission.

3. Data Security & Access Control

User accounts and consultation bookings are protected by Supabase Row-Level Security (RLS). Only authenticated patients and verified treating doctors can view consultation details.

4. Compliance

Designed in accordance with Indian Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act principles and Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) telemedicine guidelines.

gavel Terms of Service & Clinical Disclaimer

1. Clinical Decision-Support Only

SwasthaSathi is an informational decision-support platform designed to assist citizens and frontline healthcare workers. It does NOT provide formal clinical diagnoses, prescribe prescription medications, or replace in-person consultation with a licensed medical practitioner.

2. Emergency Care Protocol

If you or someone in your care is experiencing severe clinical emergencies—including crushing chest pain, difficulty breathing, altered mental status, severe bleeding, or unresponsive fever in infants—call national emergency response (108 / 112) immediately or proceed to the nearest emergency casualty ward.

3. Doctor Verification

Doctor profiles are linked with State Medical Council (SMC/NMC) registration numbers. Platform access for clinician accounts is granted following administrative credential review.
